objective: Candidate turns a pizza in place on an oven stone; PR-1387 places a tall canister over a shelf fence beneath a low upper shelf and stands it upright.
physical_skill: Candidate uses thin-tool insertion and tangential traction while preserving support; PR-1387 requires tilting a tall rigid object through constrained clearance, placing its base, and righting it.
success_condition: Candidate requires roughly 180° yaw with continuous deck contact and limited center travel. PR-1387 requires the released canister base behind the fence and the body upright, with partial credit for a controlled backward lean.
reason: Constrained tilted insertion and stand-up of a rigid canister does not duplicate centered tool-mediated rotation of continuously supported food.
